item.title: New River Community and Technical College to host Care Fair on March 7
item.description: New River Community and Technical College (CTC) wants to ensure our community is educated and healthy. On Saturday, March 7, from 10:00 a.m. to 2:00 p.m., community members can take advantage of free health screenings at the New River Community Care Fair. #RaleighCounty #WOAY

item.title: Spring Fire Season now underway until May 31
item.description: March 1 marked the start of West Virginia's annual spring fire season and the return of burning restrictions. As a reminder, burning is prohibited from 7:00 am until 5:00 pm.

item.title: Mountaineer Food Bank hosting food giveaways this week in Fayette, McDowell, and Monroe counties
item.description: The Mountaineer Food Bank has a couple of food giveaways coming up in our viewing area this week. On Tuesday, March 3, the pantry will be in Fayette and McDowell counties and on Thursday, March 5, the pantry travels to Monroe County. #FayetteCounty #McDowellCounty #MonroeCounty #WOAY

item.title: Raleigh County Parks and Recreation Authority invites community to public meeting about Lake Stephens disc golf course
item.description: The Raleigh County Parks and Recreation Authority (RCRPA) invites the community to attend a public meeting on Tuesday, March 3. Parks and Rec wants the community's feedback on the future of the Lake Stephens disc golf course, particularly the improvement of the course and expanding services. #RaleighCounty #WOAY

item.title: Salvation Army Red Shield Youth Center invites runners and walkers to participate in Rabbit Run 5K race on March 28
item.description: As the temperatures warm up, it’s the perfect time to lace up your shoes and get outside for a walk or a run. The Salvation Army Red Shield Youth Center (RSYC) is providing you with an opportunity to do it for a great cause. On Saturday, March 28, RSYC will host the Rabbit Run 5K. #RaleighCounty #WOAY

item.title: Beckley ARH hosting free Nourish and Flourish cooking class on March 3 in honor of Colon Cancer Prevention Month
item.description: Beckley ARH (BARH) invites the community to attend a free cooking class in honor of Colon Cancer Prevention Month. BARH will host a free Nourish & Flourish Cooking Class on Tuesday, March 3, in the hospital's gymnasium. #RaleighCounty #WOAY

item.title: Workforce WV hosting monthly statewide virtual job fair on March 4
item.description: If you’re looking for a job or looking to hire, mark your calendar. WorkForce West Virginia has announced its next Statewide Virtual Job Fair will take place Wednesday, March 4, from 1:00 to 3:30 p.m.

item.title: Career Opportunities at local prisons
item.description: Friday, March 13, from 9 a.m. to 2 p.m., the Federal Bureau of Prisons is hosting a joint recruitment event

item.title: Governor Morrisey celebrates the passage of Senate Bills 393 and 400
item.description: Governor Patrick Morrisey is celebrating the passage of Senate Bills 393 and 400. These bills conform West Virginia's tax code to the permanent provisions in the Trump Tax Cuts.

item.title: Tracking more winter weather, then a nice warmup
item.description: OAK HILL, WV (WOAY) – We’ve seen rain along with a mix of precipitation this evening around the area. Any wintry precipitation is mainly confined to the eastern and northeastern parts of the area (mainly in parts of Greenbrier and Pocahontas Counties).
